Meta’s AI agent Muse lands on Apple Watch and Android Wear OS
items.d: Users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation on their Apple Watch.
items.fullText: Meta is bringing its Muse AI agent to the Apple Watch and Android’s Wear OS, the company announced on Monday. With the launch, users can now interact with Meta’s AI assistant through voice calls, text messages, or dictation directly on their smartwatch. Works around the clock, and now on your wrist. Muse is now on Apple Watch and Wear OS ⌚️ pic.twitter.com/97QRap5XKz — Muse (@Muse) November 9, 2026 The smartwatch launch comes just a month after Meta introduced a dedicated iPad app for Muse. First launched on the App Store in September, the AI assistant’s expansion across Apple devices signals Meta’s growing ambitions for its consumer AI product and its focus on making Muse a central part of its ecosystem. Muse is now one of dozens of consumer-facing AI agents competing for users’ attention. Like many of its competitors, it allows users to connect their accounts to manage email, meetings, bills, and more, while also handling tasks such as booking reservations, ordering groceries, setting goals, and making purchases. Users can also personalize their Muse avatar to their liking and change it into something that resembles a person, an animal, or another type of character. Despite being a relatively new product, Meta has wasted little time introducing new capabilities to Muse. A few days ago, Meta launched Spaces , a new way to communicate and collaborate with Muse. Spaces function as dedicated conversations around specific topics, which Meta describes as “custom experiences” as they’re mini apps that are built on the fly. They appear in the sidebar of the Muse interface and bring up a focused conversation where the AI agent works toward a particular goal on the user’s behalf. Last week, Meta rolled out the ability for users in the U.S. to video chat with their Muse AI avatar. items.t: Adobe brings AI agents and new creative tools to Photoshop, Premiere, and Firefly
items.d: Adobe is taking on Figma with a new prototype builder tool in Firefly.
items.fullText: Adobe is pouring more AI into its products, including Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, and InDesign, in a major product feature announcement at its MAX event in Miami. The company is also expanding AI capabilities in its creative tool, Firefly, and releasing a Model Context Protocol (MCP) that lets other chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini use Adobe features. Adobe’s Firefly app is moving into Figma’s territory with a new prototyping tool in private beta called Builder, which lets users create designs to show off ideas. There is also a new tool to create on-brand graphs, along with an image editing tool that lets you change part of an image without changing other objects. A new AI-powered video tool in Firefly will allow users to assemble a video from clips and other elements like images and sound effects. The company is making its agent proactive and always on so that it can get more context about work and be present for any action. Adobe is also making it easier for people to take quick action, like removing the background or generating a thumbnail for a video. Image Credits: Adobe The company has already added a ton of AI features across its apps like Photoshop, Express, Premiere, and Illustrator . At the MAX event, Adobe is continuing the trend. Photoshop is getting a new relighting feature and sliders for prompt-based generative styles; Premiere will have a new color grading system for professionals and an object removal feature for video; and Lightroom has a way to correct blinking eyes and a blemish removal tool. Adobe already offers a lot of third-party models from companies like Google, Runway, ElevenLabs, Black Forest Labs, OpenAI, Kling, and ByteDance. One of its newer acquisitions, Topaz Labs , is releasing two image models, called Wonder 4 for upscaling and denoising, and ImageHDR, to turn standard images into HDR. items.t: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78 per share to reach an implied valuation of $1.404 trillion
items.d: The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis.
items.fullText: Anthropic intends to push ahead with its IPO despite shakier markets and the broader pullback from AI investing. The Claude-maker said in an updated IPO filing on Tuesday that it would be offering a total of 825 million Class A shares at an estimated price range of $70 to $78 per share. The sale is expected to raise anywhere from $57.75 billion to $64.35 billion. The company could end up being worth a hefty $1.404 trillion if its shares list at the top of the price range, on a fully diluted basis. That would represent a significant jump up from the $965 billion valuation Anthropic reached in a May fundraise , but it’s still lower than the $2 trillion the company was reportedly targeting a couple months ago. Separately, Anthropic said it had struck a deal to privately sell $26 billion of non-voting Class N stock at the IPO price to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia and TSMC. Google and Nvidia are investing $10 billion apiece. All up, Anthropic estimates net proceeds to reach somewhere between $84.6 billion and $93.7 billion (the latter if the IPO underwriters exercise their option to buy additional shares). Underwriters, including Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley, will have the option to buy up to 123.75 million more shares from Anthropic at the IPO price. As a public benefit corporation, the founders hold a Class F share with 50.1% of the voting power. The Long-Term Benefit Trust will also elect a board majority, so Class A buyers will have limited influence. Anthropic intends to start trading on the Nasdaq close to November 19, per reporting from CNBC , under the ticker symbol “ANT”. The company expects up to 20% of the offering to be allocated to retail investors. Anthropic also gave out a few new details in the updated filing. The company said its run-rate revenue reached $81 billion by the end of October, about $10 billion more than at the end of September. items.fullText: 반도체 반도체 퀄컴-코라, 脫윈도 시동…스냅드래곤 기반 'AI 네이티브 OS' 첫선 발행일 : 2026-11-10 23:00 지면 : 2026-11-11 17면 전자신문을 선호 매체로 추가 공유하기 페이스북 X(트위터) X(트위터) --> 메일 URL 복사 글자크기 설정 가 작게 가 보통 가 크게 리눅스 기반 온디바이스 인공지능(AI) 데스크톱 운영체제(OS) '코라(KORA) 로고. 출처=코라시스템즈 퀄컴 테크날러지스가 미국 실리콘밸리 스타트업 코라시스템즈와 약 1년간 공동 엔지니어링을 거쳐 온디바이스 인공지능(AI)를을위한 데스크톱 PC용 운용체계(OS)를 선보였다. 양사는 퀄컴 '스냅드래곤 X2 엘리트' 플랫폼에서 구동되는 리눅스 기반 데스크톱 OS '코라(KORA)'를 구현했다고 10일(현지시간) 밝혔다. 코라 OS는 리눅스 커널 단계부터 AI 에이전트를 직접 통합한 'AI 네이티브' 구조를 채택했다. 핵심 기술인 독자 하이브리드 추론 엔진 '코텍스(Cortex)'를 통해 스냅드래곤 X2 엘리트의 오라이온 중앙처리장치(CPU), 아드레노 그래픽처리장치(GPU), 80TOPS(초당 80조회 연산) 성능의 헥사곤 신경망처리장치(NPU)에 AI 워크로드를 실시간 배분한다. 양사는 초기 구동 최적화(브링업)와 추론 튜닝을 통해 클라우드 연결 없이 기기 내부에서 260억 파라미터(26B) 규모 거대언어모델(LLM)을 음성인식·임베딩 모델과 동시에 로컬 구동하는 데 성공했다. 고도화된 연산이 필요할 때만 클라우드 AI를 호출해 데이터 유출 위험과 비용을 낮췄다. 이번 협력은 그동안 윈도 OS에 크게 의존해 온 스냅드래곤 PC 생태계에 중요한 변곡점으로 평가된다. 기존 x86용 범용 OS를 ARM 아키텍처에 단순 이식해 쓰던 방식에서 벗어나, 설계 초기부터 스냅드래곤의 NPU와 이기종 연산 구조에 맞춘 첫 '전용 상용 AI 데스크톱 OS'가 등장했기 때문이다. 퀄컴 입장에서는 MS의 업데이트나 API 지원에 종속되지 않고 칩셋의 온디바이스 AI 성능을 온전히 입증할 독자 레퍼런스를 확보하게 됐다. 또한 데이터 주권이 중요한 글로벌 기업·공공(소버린 AI) PC 시장을 공략할 발판이기도 하다. 코라 시스템즈는 모바일 OS '사이아노젠' CEO 출신 커트 맥마스터 최고경영자(CEO), 구글 안드로이드 글로벌 파트너십을 총괄했던 존 래거링 최고사업책임자(CBO), 리눅스 게이밍 OS '플레이트론'을 주도한 프랑크 드 지롤라미 최고기술책임자(CTO)가 설립한 기업이다. 삼성넥스트와 스퀘어에닉스 등이 주요 투자사로 참여하고 있다. 상용화 시점은 오는 2027년이다. 사우디아라비아 국부펀드(PIF) 산하 AI 기업 휴메인(HUMAIN)과 공동 개발한 기업용 '휴메인 OS'가 2027년 첫 스냅드래곤 X2 기반 리눅스 OEM PC로 출시되며, 이어 개발자·크리에이터용 '코라 OS'가 순차 탑재될 예정이다. 케다르 콘답 퀄컴 수석부사장은 “스냅드래곤 X2 엘리트의 '온디바이스 AI 역량'을 중심에 둔 완전하나 리눅스 데스크톱 OS가 구현된다”며 “2027년 휴메인 OS와 코라가 탑재된 스냅드래곤 PC 출시를 기대한다”고 말했다. 스냅드래곤 X2 엘리트. 출처=퀄컴 이형두 기자 dudu@etnews.com

items.d: The AI company is expected to set its valuation range this week, the Wall Street Journal reported.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 5:27 PM PST · November 9, 2026 Image Credits: Ruhani Kaur/Bloomberg / Getty Images Marina Temkin Anthropic reportedly plans to move forward with IPO plans Launching a major tech IPO would seem risky right now, shortly after one of Nasdaq’s biggest sell-offs and amid revelations that a CEO central to the AI boom had an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. But that isn’t deterring Anthropic, which is moving ahead with its listing plans, according to The Wall Street Journal . Anthropic plans to set a valuation range this week and begin trading on Thursday or Friday of next week, the Journal reported. Investors will look to Anthropic’s valuation to gauge the strength of the AI boom. Some institutional investors are now pushing for a valuation below the $1.5 trillion target discussed as recently as last week, a figure that was itself considerably below the $2 trillion floated a few months ago, the report said. OpenAI, Anthropic’s main rival, was reportedly valued at $1.25 trillion last week after the ChatGPT maker raised $11 billion in fresh capital, short of the $20 billion it had initially sought. items.fullText: Korea’s AI Ecosystem Advances and Secures Agentic AI With NVIDIA Hyundai Motor Group and AIM Intelligence explore NVIDIA NemoClaw and OpenShell for secure enterprise agents, and LG AI Research opens API for ‘K-EXAONE-2.5’ trained on Nemotron datasets. November 8, 2026 by Nicola Sessions 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! As AI agents take on more work, they need capable open models and security that advances alongside them. Hyundai Motor Group is exploring NVIDIA NemoClaw blueprints and the NVIDIA OpenShell runtime, while AIM Intelligence is integrating its Starfort platform with NVIDIA OpenShell to support secure AI agents for employee productivity and enterprise workflows . A key component of the NVIDIA Open Agent Safety Platform, OpenShell provides a secure runtime with sandboxed execution and policy-based controls to safeguard sensitive data, manage access to enterprise tools and govern autonomous agent actions. AIM Intelligence , a Korean AI security company, is integrating its Starfort agent control platform with NVIDIA OpenShell. The goal is to combine OpenShell’s runtime access controls with Starfort’s detection of malicious instructions and data leakage. The company is also considering a preliminary proof of concept for the public energy sector, with potential applications across enterprise, industrial and robotics environments. On the model side, LG AI Research is opening application programming interface access for K-EXAONE-2.5, developed using NVIDIA Nemotron datasets, including Nemotron-Personas-Korea . Nemotron-Personas-Korea is an open dataset of 7 million fully synthetic Korean personas, grounded in official Korean statistics, that model builders use to ground training data and evaluation in Korean contexts. NVIDIA Nemotron is a family of open models, datasets and techniques that help developers build specialized, efficient AI agents. items.fullText: Vera Delivers the Best of Both Worlds: Highest Throughput and Fastest Agents November 5, 2026 by Hannah Coutand 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! AI agents do more than generate answers. They search for information, query databases, write and test code and take action. Each of those steps relies on a CPU, with agents moving between GPU reasoning and CPU execution throughout a task. As businesses put more agents to work, AI factories need CPUs that can execute those steps quickly and support many agents at once, all within the limits of available power. What this means: AI infrastructure providers need to support more agents without making each one wait longer to get work done. And critically, AI factories are power limited. This means operators need to choose infrastructure that maximizes the work done for every watt. Why it matters: NVIDIA Vera delivers both fast agent performance and high capacity per watt within a single CPU. That gives providers one CPU for a range of agent workloads, rather than having to mix and match fast and dense x86 parts to balance speed and capacity. The data that proves it: In a 100-megawatt data center comparison, NVIDIA found that a single Vera CPU performs better than the fastest x86 CPU and the most energy-efficient x86 CPU. Vera delivers industry-leading agent speed while enabling 1.6x more agents per watt versus the fastest x86 CPU. Vera delivers 2x faster agent speed with leading energy efficiency compared with the most energy-efficient x86 CPU. Partners are already putting Vera to work. Early adopters see the same exceptional performance in production-style tests: Perplexity : Ran agentic coding tasks 1.5x faster with Vera than on traditional CPUs. Perplexity plans to deploy Vera in an upcoming production system. The BondLab team uses SideFX Houdini and the NVIDIA ovrtx library to develop materials, lighting and the final rendered appearance. In one experiment, Scarcella guided Astra to recreate an OP-1 portable synthesizer using product images, manuals and technical direction. items.fullText: The Wizard of Open Weights: Chris Alexiuk Makes AI Easy With Open Models With a parakeet, a webcam and a conviction that AI belongs to everyone — how one NVIDIAN became NVIDIA Nemotron’s loudest advocate. November 5, 2026 by Matthew Leib 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Chris Alexiuk has a simple rule about open source AI: If you believe in it, be loud about it. “We should be shouting about this technology from the rooftops,” said Alexiuk, a Toronto-based senior product research engineer in deep learning at NVIDIA who specializes in making open large language models (LLMs) practical for working developers. Alexiuk’s preferred “rooftop” is YouTube , where he’s built a following teaching curious thousands how to build, fine-tune, evaluate and ship production LLM applications and agents. “I think the people who will most help us understand how to build and apply AI likely haven’t even heard of it yet,” he said. “Trying to get knowledge and information out to as many people as humanly possible is what continues to drive me.” Bringing NVIDIA Nemotron to Developers Everywhere Having spent years teaching developers to build with open models, Alexiuk has concluded that transparency isn’t a feature of good AI; it’s the precondition for it. “Fully open source AI is necessary for the democratization of intelligence,” he said. “You should have access to the weights, the data that went into it, the training recipes, everything.” That’s why, on his LinkedIn profile, Alexiuk styles himself “No. 1 Nemotron Fan,” referring to the NVIDIA Nemotron family of open source, multimodal models built for long-running, self-evolving and specialized AI agents. “I think Nemotron is the most important project that exists,” said Alexiuk, who also uses the pseudonym “Joe Nemotron” across social media. “I’m a firm believer that openness is a very important thing to undertake, so I’m going to be the No. 1 fan of whoever is doing that the best. items.fullText: More Performance From Every Byte: How Full-Stack Codesign Solves AI’s Memory Challenge November 5, 2026 by Amr Elmeleegy 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Larger models, longer contexts and agentic applications are increasing GPU memory pressure while supply tightens and prices rise — a trend expected to continue through the near term. NVIDIA works closely with memory partners to rapidly adopt the latest memory technologies. NVIDIA was first to adopt HBM3e and HBM4 technologies into an accelerated computing stack. But the approach isn’t to simply pack more memory onto the GPU. It’s full-stack codesign. NVIDIA intentionally designs GPUs, CPUs, networking, storage and software together to get more useful work out of memory at every layer of the AI factory. That matters because an AI factory runs on a memory and storage hierarchy. GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) is the fastest, most expensive and most contested tier — with model weights and KV cache competing for limited capacity. Below it sit CPU memory, local SSDs and shared storage, each trading speed for more capacity at a lower cost per bit. How much useful work a byte does depends on how well the whole hierarchy is used: shrinking what must be stored, placing it on the right tier and bringing it back to the GPU before it’s needed. Byte for byte, NVIDIA makes the most efficient use of memory at every layer — and the results show it. From NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra to the Vera Rubin platform, HBM capacity per GPU rose roughly 3%, while agentic throughput per dollar rose by up to 30x on SemiAnalysis AgentX. Agentic Inference Is Putting More Pressure on HBM Frontier models now have trillions of parameters — the values that hold what an AI model learned in training. KV cache, which holds the context the model needs to understand each active request without reprocessing the same information, is also expanding. items.fullText: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI From infrastructure planning and transportation to public services, cities are using NVIDIA-powered applications to address local needs and expand capacity for the broader AI ecosystem. November 2, 2026 by Esther Lee 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Cities generate enormous amounts of data from cameras, sensors and operational systems, but turning it into useful action — for planning, maintenance and public services — remains a challenge. Physical and agentic AI offer new ways to close that gap, from digital twins for infrastructure planning to vision and service agents, while keeping local governments in control of how sensitive data is processed and used. Building on initiatives announced at GTC Berlin , NVIDIA and its partners are expanding physical AI and AI agents to cities worldwide. Shared computing infrastructure gives city departments, neighboring municipalities and local developers a common foundation to build on — extending services without each organization having to acquire and manage resources of their own. Agentic AI for Cities From resident services to vision agents, cities are adopting NVIDIA agentic AI to deliver faster, more responsive public services. City teams don’t need a massive infrastructure investment to get started building these AI services: depending on the workload, NVIDIA RTX workstations or a small GPU system may be enough. In Spain, 1MillionBot combines open source ALIA models trained at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center with NVIDIA Nemotron and other models in resident-service agents for Madrid Digital (Comunidad de Madrid), Administració Oberta de Catalunya and 150+ deployments across Spain, handling municipal procedures, appointment requests, urban-planning incidents and service inquiries. items.fullText: 삼성, 샘 올트먼과 ‘AI 혁신’ 간담회 개최 ‘AI Driven’ 경영 강화… 전사적 AX 추진 가속 2026/10/31 AI 요약 새로운 뉴스룸 AI 기능을 살펴보세요! 닫기 --> AUDIO Play Download 공유 레이어 열기 인쇄하기 삼성, 샘 올트먼 CEO 초청해 AI 시대 미래 경영 전략 논의 삼성은 31일 경기도 용인 삼성인력개발원에서 삼성전자 등 주요 관계사 사장단을 대상으로 샘 올트먼(Sam Altman) OpenAI CEO 초청 간담회를 개최했다. 이날 간담회에는 전자·금융·바이오 등 삼성 관계사 사장단 50여 명이 참석했으며, 샘 올트먼 CEO와 함께 ‘AI가 바꿀 다음 10년, 기업의 선택’을 주제로 진행됐다. 삼성 사장단과 샘 올트먼 CEO는 AI 기술의 발전 방향과 활용 가능성을 살펴보고, 이를 바탕으로 새롭게 형성될 시장과 사업 기회에 대한 의견을 나눴다. 또한 AI가 기업의 의사결정과 조직 운영에 미칠 영향을 짚어보며, 새로운 경영 환경에서 경영진이 갖춰야 할 역량에 대해서도 소통했다. 삼성은 전사적 AX 추진을 위한 사장단 교육의 일환으로 경영진의 AI 이해도를 높이고 미래 경영 전략을 모색하기 위해 이번 간담회를 마련했다. 삼성은 글로벌 AI 혁신을 주도하는 OpenAI의 CEO를 초청하는 등 AI 시대의 변화에 선제적으로 대응하고 미래 경쟁력을 강화하는 데 힘을 쏟고 있다. AI 시대의 경쟁력이 경영진의 판단력과 실행력에서 비롯된다는 인식 아래, 사장단이 앞장서 AI를 배우고 활용하는 문화를 확산시키고 있다. 삼성전자와 OpenAI는 지난해 10월 글로벌 AI 인프라 구축을 위한 협력 의향서(LOI)를 체결하고, OpenAI의 스타게이트 프로젝트에 필요한 메모리 반도체 공급을 추진해 왔다. 당시 삼성SDS는 AI 데이터센터 구축과 기업용 AI 서비스 분야에서 협력하기로 했으며, 삼성물산과 삼성중공업은 해상 부유식 데이터센터 공동 개발을 진행하기로 했다. 올해 7월에는 이재용 삼성전자 회장이 미국 샌프란시스코 OpenAI 본사를 방문하는 등 양사 간 교류도 지속해 왔다. 삼성 사장단, 지난 6월에 이어 생성형 AI 집중교육 추가 진행 삼성 사장단은 이날 샘 올트먼 CEO와의 간담회에 앞서 생성형 AI 실습 교육을 진행했다. 지난 6월 사장단을 대상으로 첫 AI 집중교육을 실시한 데 이어, 4개월 만에 시행된 추가 교육이다. 삼성은 사장단부터 AI 기술을 직접 익히고 업무에 적용할 수 있도록 교육 프로그램을 지속 운영하고 있으며, 이를 실제 활용할 수 있는 능력을 높이는 데 초점을 맞췄다. 사장단은 흩어진 경영 자료를 AI로 정리해 자신만의 ‘지식저장소’를 구성하고, 의사결정에 AI를 활용하는 역량을 높였다. 삼성, ‘AI Driven’ 경영 본격화… 전사적 AI 대전환 추진 삼성은 지난 6월부터 연구개발에서 생산·마케팅·지원 업무까지 전 분야에 AI를 도입하는 ‘AI 대전환’을 본격 추진하고 있다. AI를 활용해 업무 생산성과 사업 경쟁력을 높이고, 제품과 서비스는 물론 기업 운영 전반에 AI를 접목해 나갈 계획이다. 이를 위해 관계사별 사업 특성과 업무 환경에 맞는 AI 활용 방안을 마련하고, 임직원들이 AI를 적극적으로 활용할 수 있는 기반을 확대하고 있다. 지난 6월 사장단 교육을 시작으로 약 2,300명의 임원을 대상으로 교육을 추진했으며, 교육 대상을 일반 직원까지 확대해 2027년 2월까지 전 임직원 대상 AI 교육을 완료한다는 목표를 제시했다. 삼성은 관계사별 AI 전담조직을 구축하고, 외부 생성형 AI 서비스의 업무 활용도 확대하고 있다. AI 전담조직은 각 회사의 사업 특성에 맞는 AX 전략을 수립하고, 데이터와 AI 모델의 운영 및 활용을 지원하는 역할을 한다. 삼성은 앞으로 AI 기술의 발전과 산업 환경 변화에 선제적으로 대응하는 한편, 관계사별 AX 추진 성과를 지속 점검하고 실행 과제를 구체화해 AI 중심의 경영 체계를 정착시

items.fullText: Things That Go Beep in the Night: Agentic AI Joins the Search for Extraterrestrial Signals Scientists at the Allen Telescope Array have integrated the NVIDIA Holoscan platform to search for signals that may come from aliens — or the AI they built. October 30, 2026 by Chris Porter 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! While science fiction lore tells us that humans will meet extraterrestrial life in the form of little green men, the detail that should raise hairs this Halloween is this: the search for extraterrestrial intelligence took a major leap forward with AI, and it increasingly focuses on AI agents built by humans listening for AI agents built by aliens. Some scientists have suggested that extraterrestrial civilizations, if they exist, could be billions of years older than humanity. Such civilizations might have developed technologies far beyond humanity’s, including forms of AI. Breakthrough Listen and the SETI Institute are bringing agentic AI into the daily search for extraterrestrial intelligence. At the Allen Telescope Array in Northern California, agents can now steer the instrument, enhance and correct incoming data, and apply AI models to the incoming stream — all from a single natural language request. The NVIDIA Holoscan platform processes the massive streams of sensor data, giving agents live data to act on. The result is a faster, more adaptable search for potential signals from extraterrestrial life and technologies. “As our new agentic observatories reach out into the universe, what they find may have much more in common with themselves than with the humans who created them,” said Andrew Siemion, Bernard M. Oliver chair for SETI at the SETI Institute and principal investigator of Breakthrough Listen. “But this isn’t something to fear.
